name: Out-of-Core Rendering with Virtual Page Tables
definition: A strategy for managing large-scale data uploads using virtual page tables and on-demand brick transfers, where volumes are preprocessed, mipmapped, and bricked to be uploaded to GPU with dynamic requests.
summary: Out-of-core rendering with virtual page tables visualizes massive volume datasets by mapping logical regions to physical GPU memory via a flat page table, enabling on-demand brick transfers that reduce indirections and page misses compared to dense grid or hierarchical methods.
